feature.reports: We tell you what we found

hospital_visit.intro: Professional support for hospital appointments, treatment and follow-ups.
hospital_visit.photoAlt: A helper walking with an older man into a hospital
hospital_visit.about: A trained companion takes your loved one to the hospital and stays with them through registration, consultations, tests and the pharmacy, then brings them home. We can drive them in our vehicle or in your own car.
included: Help at the hospital: queues, registration and paperwork
Someone to stay with your loved one
Updates for the family by email
hospital_visit.pricing: The price depends on the distance and how long the visit takes. In our vehicle we charge by distance for the round trip; in your own car, by the time spent driving. Both add the hours of the visit.

driver.intro: A careful, identity-checked driver for appointments, family visits and longer trips.
driver.photoAlt: A driver smiling at the wheel of a car
driver.about: Book a driver to take your loved one wherever they need to go. We can drive your own car, or bring a small car or a van. For longer trips, book the same driver for several days.
included: Your car, or our car or van
The same driver for multi-day trips
driver.pricing: In our vehicle, the price is set by the one-way distance, with a minimum charge. If we drive your car, it's a flat fee. Our team quotes multi-day trips.

companion.intro: A friendly face at the bank, an office or the shops.
companion.photoAlt: A helper chatting with an older woman on a bench
companion.about: A companion goes with your loved one to the bank, government offices, the shops or anywhere they'd rather not go alone. They can help with forms, wait in queues and carry things.
included: By the hour, or for several days
companion.pricing: Our team looks at what you need and emails you a quote. You pay only if you accept it.

property.intro: We look in on your home while you're away.
property.photoAlt: A helper checking the front door of a house
property.about: A trusted helper visits your home or property to check all is well, handles keys, and arranges any cleaning or repairs you ask for.
included: A visit to check inside and out
Cleaning or repairs arranged on request
We tell you what we found
property.pricing: Our team looks at what you need and emails you a quote. You pay only if you accept it.

gift.intro: We arrange a surprise for someone you love and deliver it with care.
gift.photoAlt: A wrapped gift being handed to a smiling woman
gift.about: Tell us the occasion and who it's for. We'll help choose the gift, add your message and deliver it in person on the day you pick.
gift.pricing: Our team looks at what you need and emails you a quote. You pay only if you accept it.

camera.intro: A photographer for your event, family day or celebration.
camera.photoAlt: A photographer taking a family photo
camera.about: Book a photographer for a birthday, a wedding, a family gathering or any day worth remembering. Tell us the occasion and what you'd like captured.
included: As many hours as you need
camera.pricing: Our team looks at what you need and emails you a quote. You pay only if you accept it.

notice.q: How far ahead do I need to book?
notice.a: At least 48 hours before the start, so our team can plan the right helper.

someoneElse.q: Can I book for a parent or someone else?
someoneElse.a: Yes. Choose "Someone else" and add their name and mobile number so the helper can call them on the day.

payment.a: Online, in a secure checkout. When we can price a booking straight away you pay as you book. Otherwise our team emails you a quote, and you pay only if you accept it.

where.a: All our services take place in India, and times are India time (IST).

helpers.a: Every helper is identity-checked before they work with us, and our team assigns the right person for your booking.
